早期的几代人曾花费数年甚至一生的时间在遥远的恒星间漂泊，而我们现代的驱动装置只需几天就能让方舟舰在各个星系间穿梭。随着飞船冲入超空间航道网，恒星在我们的传感器中飞速掠过，它们的光线不断发生位移与扭曲。

[Root.GetName]方舟舰正以我们祖先难以想象的速度穿越虚空。

早期的几代人曾花费数年甚至一生的时间在遥远的恒星间漂泊，而我们现代的驱动装置只需几天就能让方舟舰在各个星系间穿梭。随着飞船冲入超空间航道网，恒星在我们的传感器中飞速掠过，它们的光线不断发生位移与扭曲。

对于船上的许多人来说，这种经历确实会产生一种奇特的迷失感。一些人开始寻求微小的慰藉，以对抗这种感官冲击；而另一些人则坚持认为，只要给予足够的时间，我们的心智终将学会跟上方舟舰不断加速的旅程。
texts.en:
The Arkship [Root.GetName] now crosses the void at speeds our ancestors could scarcely have imagined.

Where earlier generations spent years, even lifetimes, drifting between distant stars, our modern drives hurl the Arkship from system to system in a matter of days. The stars streak past our sensors in rapid succession, their light shifting and distorting as the ship plunges through the hyperlane network.

For many aboard, the experience has proven strangely disorienting. Some have begun seeking small ways to anchor themselves against the sensation. Others insist that, given time, our minds will simply learn to keep pace with the Arkship's accelerating journey.

# 惊天骇动 / A Staggering Motion

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt、common/special_projects/06_projects_nomads.txt、common/event_chains/00_event_chains_nomads.txt · 游牧帝国内容 nomad content · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的方舟随机事件：隐藏事件 arkship.1（nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49）定期检查，游戏前5年不会发生，每次约三分之一几率（中期前×1.5；近期参战或所有方舟都在战斗时为0）调用 generate_arkship_event 从 mobile_arkship_random_events 池（00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006，24项，总权重460）中抽取一件，否则3–5年后再试。多数事件设置一次性标记（个别如“出发！”可发生两次）；结束后约10–15年再重新开始检查。（池中权重 20/460，00_on_actions.txt:3991）
Nomad arkship random event: hidden arkship.1 (nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49) checks periodically — never in the first 5 years, about one in three (×1.5 before mid game, 0 during recent war or when every arkship is fighting) — and draws one episode from mobile_arkship_random_events (00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006, 24 entries, total weight 460); otherwise it retries in 3–5 years. Most episodes set a once-only flag (Start Your Engines can happen twice); after it ends the loop resumes roughly 10–15 years later. (pool weight 20/460, 00_on_actions.txt:3991)

条件：非格式塔；游戏开始后不超过30年；非“可汗后裔”起源；只发生一次。
Conditions: non-gestalt; within 30 years of game start; not Heirs of the Khan; once.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 方舟航速之快让习惯漂流的居民不适：组织锻炼，或在内部广播播放引擎声。单篇事件。
  The arkship's new speed unsettles its people: organise exercise, or broadcast engine noise. Single event.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无后续。
  No follow-ups.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特殊差异。
  No notable variants.

  Checked the arkship loop and pool weights, this episode's trigger and once-flag, options, projects, random weights and delays (180 days base).
